races.paceDynamic: Mind Over Matter will be the sole pace-setter from the gates, with Milford Grange likely tracking in second through the early stages. With only one confirmed front runner, Mind Over Matter can dictate comfortable fractions without pressure, setting up a sustainable tempo that won't collapse in the final furlong. The large contingent of hold-up horses (The Untamed, Vega Storm, Kode Grey) will rely on the pace holding up, but with such an uncontested lead, this race shape strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can stay close to the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Runner Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Mind Over Matter gets an easy lead and maintains stamina over 6f
scenarios.body: Mind Over Matter dictates ideal fractions and has enough left to resist late challengers. The hold-up horses find the pace too steady and lack the acceleration needed to reel in the leader.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the steady pace allows closers to unleash finishing kicks
scenarios.body: The Untamed and Vega Storm benefit from the pedestrian early tempo to mount strong late challenges. Mind Over Matter's long absence and modest recent form tell as fresher legs prevail.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Milford Grange travels strongly behind Mind Over Matter throughout
scenarios.body: Milford Grange gets the perfect stalking trip and has both tactical position and recent race fitness advantage. The Michael Easterby runner times his challenge perfectly as Mind Over Matter weakens.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Mind Over Matter goes too slowly and multiple horses challenge simultaneously
scenarios.body: The tempo becomes so sedate that it turns into a sprint finish where any horse can win. This creates chaos in the final furlong with no clear pace advantage.

watchPoints.text: Mind Over Matter showing any signs of ring-rustiness or sweating heavily given the 220-day layoff returning to action.

races.paceDynamic: Storm Esme stands alone as the confirmed front runner and will face no pressure through early fractions, allowing her to dictate terms from the rail. The prominent brigade of Bye Law, Mighty Magnus, Hvar and Rogue Temptation will settle in behind but none are aggressive early types. This creates a tactical speed battle where Storm Esme can control the tempo and kick for home, while hold-up horses like Cotai Belle, Wise Crack and Head For Freedom face the challenge of making up ground against a controlled pace. This race shape clearly favours front runners and early prominent horses who can position close to the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Storm Esme Controls All
scenarios.trigger: If Storm Esme breaks cleanly and faces no early pressure from the prominent runners
scenarios.body: She dictates moderate fractions and has enough left to repel late challenges, proving her class advantage. The hold-up horses struggle to make significant inroads against the controlled tempo.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressure Builds
scenarios.trigger: If Mighty Magnus or Bye Law press Storm Esme earlier than expected in the race
scenarios.body: The increased pace sets up perfectly for the closer brigade to sweep past tiring leaders in the final furlong. Cotai Belle and Yy Spirit benefit most from the honest gallop.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Storm Esme Fades Late
scenarios.trigger: If Storm Esme's 184-day layoff tells in the closing stages despite controlling the pace
scenarios.body: The prominent runners who stayed close prove strongest, with Mighty Magnus and Hvar having the tactical speed to capitalise. Their recent form gives them the edge over the rusty favourite.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Closer Surprise Package
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint finish from the 2f pole
scenarios.body: Empress Olivia's recent run and low weight become decisive factors as she times her challenge perfectly. The hold-up horses finally get their ideal scenario despite the tactical disadvantage.

races.paceDynamic: Wild Clary stands alone as the only confirmed front-runner in this 16-runner field, giving her a clear advantage to dictate terms without early pressure. The prominent racers like Sixtygeesbaby, Kats Bob, It Just Takes Time, Kodiac Thriller, Fortamour, American Style and Roberto Caro will settle just behind but none have the natural speed to challenge Wild Clary's early supremacy. With half the field adopting hold-up tactics including Almarada Prince, Mister Sox, Rock Opera, Modern Times, Intervention, Wen Moon, Another Investment and Lesley's Boy, the pace will be genuinely run but sustainable. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers who can track the lone leader and hold-up horses who can benefit from the strong gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Wild Clary maintains control without being headed too early in the straight
scenarios.body: The lone leader gets a soft lead and kicks clear, while those tracking her get first run on the closers. This setup perfectly suits prominent racers with tactical speed.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Closer Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses get the perfect setup from Wild Clary's honest pace
scenarios.body: The strong gallop sets up perfectly for the back markers who come with sustained runs. Modern Times and Mister Sox have the class to capitalize on this scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Pounce
scenarios.trigger: If Wild Clary weakens inside the final furlong after setting the pace
scenarios.body: The tracking prominent horses inherit the lead as the pace-setter tires. Sixtygeesbaby and American Style are best placed to strike.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Wild Clary goes too fast early under pressure from the prominent pack
scenarios.body: The race becomes messy with no clear pace advantage, favoring horses with natural finishing speed regardless of position.

watchPoints.text: Wild Clary's early fractions will determine the entire complexion - if she goes too fast the race falls apart

The prominent pack of six horses could get in each other's way if they all commit together

races.paceDynamic: Pomme Pomme is the sole natural leader and will control the tempo from flag to finish with no pace pressure from this hold-up heavy field. Spioradalta and Glistening Nights may sit handy but neither consistently forces the pace, leaving Pomme Pomme to dictate a comfortable gallop. The sustained pace will suit front-runners and prominent racers who can track the leader without pressure, while the large contingent of hold-up horses face a tactical disadvantage. This race shape strongly favours front-running and prominent horses who can position close to the uncontested leader.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Pomme Pomme gets an easy lead and kicks clear turning for home.
scenarios.body: The 237-day break concern evaporates as the 5lb claimer enjoys a perfect trip on the front end without pace pressure. Hold-up horses struggle to peg back the leader who has controlled every yard of the race.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Pounces
scenarios.trigger: If Spioradalta or Glistening Nights sit handy and outkick the leader late.
scenarios.body: The tracking horses get the perfect scenario behind the uncontested leader then use superior finishing speed in the final furlong. Pomme Pomme's long absence tells when challenged by fresher legs.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Overcomes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly crawling and one hold-up horse gets a clear run.
scenarios.body: Sir William or Raulin finds the gaps and benefits from recent form despite the tactical disadvantage. The slow pace negates the front-runner's advantage and allows time for the closers to wind up.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Pomme Pomme goes too slow early and multiple horses challenge simultaneously.
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader sets suicidal fractions that suit nobody, creating a messy sprint finish where any horse can win. Class and current form become more important than running style in a blanket finish.

watchPoints.text: Pomme Pomme's 237-day absence could see stamina drain rapidly in the final furlong despite tactical advantage.

Watch for Spioradalta to sit second or third early as the main danger to track the uncontested leader.
Any early pace injection from Glistening Nights would completely change the race dynamic and help the hold-up horses.

races.paceDynamic: Saxon Prince will likely lead from the start with Gwen's Girl, Domination, and potentially Sailor Batt tracking close behind in the early stages. With 8 of 11 runners showing hold-up tendencies, the early pace should be modest rather than frantic, allowing Saxon Prince to dictate comfortable fractions. The race will develop into a sustained gallop from the 3-furlong pole as the large hold-up brigade starts to make their moves. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can position handily and kick when the pace lifts, rather than hold-up horses who will face traffic problems in a bunched field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Saxon Prince sets steady fractions and the prominent runners get first run
scenarios.body: The early leaders avoid the traffic that will inevitably develop behind them as 8 hold-up horses try to find racing room simultaneously. Saxon Prince, Gwen's Girl, and Domination can utilize their forward positions to strike decisively.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Traffic Nightmare
scenarios.trigger: If the large hold-up brigade gets severely hampered by lack of racing room
scenarios.body: The bunched field creates a wall of horses that prevents several hold-up runners from getting clear runs when they need them most. Only the hold-up horses with the best jockeys and racing luck can navigate through.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Saxon Prince goes too slow early and gets swamped by superior finishing speed
scenarios.body: The modest early gallop plays into the hands of the best finishers who can overcome positioning disadvantages with raw ability. The race becomes a pure test of who has the most left in the tank.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Longshot Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If the favorites get caught up in trouble and a well-positioned outsider capitalizes
scenarios.body: The chaos of multiple hold-up horses and potential traffic issues creates opportunities for the lesser-fancied runners to slip through and grab place money. Weight allowances become crucial.

watchPoints.text: Saxon Prince must be watched for early speed - if he fails to lead, the entire pace scenario changes and chaos could ensue
Traffic problems will be severe in the home straight with 8 hold-up horses converging simultaneously, watch for multiple hard-luck stories
Gwen's Girl and Domination both returning from 180+ day breaks, watch for any signs of rustiness affecting their ability to capitalize on forward positions
Jamie Gormley on Walk On Walk On getting 5lbs off for the claim plus very light weight, watch if he can secure a dream passage through traffic
Fickle McSelfish and Ciao Capo both have recent Ripon form, watch if course familiarity helps them navigate the expected trouble

races.paceDynamic: Garden Oasis will face no early pressure as the lone confirmed front-runner, allowing him to dictate terms through sensible fractions. Behind him, Empirestateofmind, Walsingham, Good Morning Alex and Milteye will create significant congestion in the prominent positions, with traffic problems likely emerging 2-3 furlongs out as they jostle for racing room. The hold-up brigade of Barley, Cosmos Raj, Mr Mistoffelees, On The River and Chesneys Charm will need the pace to collapse or hope the prominent runners compromise each other. This race shape strongly favours the lone leader Garden Oasis and any hold-up horse that can find a clear passage, as the prominent runners will likely neutralise each other in a tactical bottleneck.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Lone Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Garden Oasis gets soft fractions and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The veteran exploits his tactical advantage with no early pressure, while the prominent quartet get in each other's way when it matters. His 190-day break becomes irrelevant if he can steal a march on a struggling pack.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Traffic Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the four prominent runners create a wall of horses that blocks the hold-up horses
scenarios.body: Empirestateofmind or Walsingham benefit from the early positioning battle while Garden Oasis weakens in the closing stages. The hold-up horses find no gaps and finish with unlucky-in-running comments.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Hero Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Garden Oasis goes too fast early or the prominent horses set up a strong pace
scenarios.body: Barley or Mr Mistoffelees time their challenge perfectly as the early leaders weaken in the final furlong. The Easterby second-string or the consistent Mr Mistoffelees capitalise on a truly-run race.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Package Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and it becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: Chesneys Charm's light weight and recent form progression sees him quicken past tiring rivals in a slowly-run affair. The 4-year-old benefits from his minimal 128lbs burden and Grant Tuer's recent 20% strike-rate.
